name: The Atomic Punk
caption: A former CWWF USA Champion who debuted on the Mutant/Sci-fi roster and won by splashing a giant wall of concrete onto his opponent.

name: Ogre
caption: A giant caveman-styled mutant wrestler who fell to The Atomic Punk in his own division debut.

name: T-4
caption: A shapeshifting wrestler who defeated Lucky II in a hell-in-a-cell match by turning into an alien and spitting acid on him.

name: Lucky II
caption: A shapeshifting wrestler who lost a hell-in-a-cell match to T-4 despite morphing through a bear, a hawk, a bull, and a giant.

name: Nitro Glycerine
caption: A former UWP champion, newly transformed into a Mutant/Sci-fi division wrestler, who defeated Cyber Ninja with his own finisher.

name: Cyber Ninja
caption: A teleporting ninja-styled wrestler who lost to Nitro Glycerine after a rapid exchange of kicks.

name: Satan
caption: The self-proclaimed King of Hell and father of the S.O.S. stable, who beat Spawn with help from his own ally Venom.
